notes.title: 10 new levels - Update 25
notes.content:
10 levels from the original game has been added!

- Added coyote time.
- Added reset key. Use 'R' to instantly reset the level.
- Timer now starts on first input instead of scene load.
- Removed Death screen. Respawn immediately without needing to confirm.
- Reduced load times.

notes.title: Bean: Remade Update
notes.content:
Bean: Remake Update Log:

6 series - Red Series, Orange Series, Yellow Series, Green Series, Blue series, Purple Series

Each series is equivalent to 3-5 levels in the original game.

- New grappling animation
- Blue sphere shows where you're grappling
- New grappling physics
- New player movement
- Soundtracks (Made by KrossKancel) rotate 3 tracks
- Your best time is saved in-game (Can be seen in the levels menu or in each level)
- When you complete a series, your time is shown
- New brighter colors and textures
- Objects have a black cartoon outline
- Improved graphics

These are just some of many new improvements. If you have any suggestions, let the developer know in the Discord server: [url=https://discord.gg/Mv8WFFUEdv]https://discord.gg/Mv8WFFUEdv[/url]

Youtube Channels: [url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCsW3m1jsgtjgKXkA3owFrYw]AJ[/url], [url=https://www.youtube.com/@proptrio]Propeller Trio[/url]

notes.title: Bean Update #20 (Patch Update)
notes.content:
BEAN UPDATE #20

Because of the big update, there has been tons of bugs and things needed to be added :)
Multiplayer is also being added in the next update!

BUGS
- Fixed the bug where it locks your cursor in the level selector after openeing the pause menu
- Fixed the bug where it locks your cursor after going back to the main menu from the in-game pause menu
- Fixed the bug where it locks your cursor in the inventory menu
- Fixed the bug where the Rigibody force does not stop on death.

SPEEDRUN.COM
- Added Legacy Speedrun.com category
- Runs have been continued

UI RELATED
- Added Download Legacy Button
- Added Music Slider
- Added Restart button
- Added Music Slider Saving
- Removed Level Selector UI

GENERAL UPDATES
- Added Collectable Can of Beans for 5 second speed
- You slide more instead of just completely stopping after landing a jump
- You now can close the controls menu by pressing 'ESC'
- Modified player jump movement speed
- Modified player movement speed
- Removed broken mac support
- Removed old splash screen
- Removed close button on controls page
- Removed Merch Link, Steam doesn't like the merch link in the Main Menu
- Updated gold orb textures


If you find anymore bugs, please report them in the discord server linked below.
